evaluation_setting: ScienceQA validation samples with image context; multiple-choice closed-set answer prediction
prompt: Answer the visual multiple-choice question using the provided image and question. Answer with exactly one option letter (A, B, C, ...). Do not provide any explanation.
prompt_composition: <task prompt> + optional Context + Question + enumerated Choices
output_normalization: strip + uppercase only; prediction must exactly equal one valid option letter
checkpoint_note: Checkpoint disk size includes components not necessarily loaded when enable_audio_output=False.
throughput_note: Request QPS values are sequential batch-1 service-rate proxies (1000 / mean latency), not load-tested concurrent throughput.
memory_note: Torch allocator memory is framework-specific auxiliary data; final deployment VRAM comparison uses process-level NVML.

latency_definition.e2e_latency: instruction construction + local image read/decode + multimodal preprocessing + H2D + model.generate() + decode + closed-set postprocessing
